description: Non-PEF screening fronts with selected ranks and feed-normalized objectives
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Rank 0 is economic endpoint (rose); rank 10 is environmental endpoint (green). Electricity-only attributional burden at 0.20 kg CO₂e/kWh. Throughput varies; front is screening-level.

description: Electricity-only attributional burden and uncharacterized heat/inventory across selected non-PEF routes
source_dataset: Exact BioSTEAM reports; annual process pathway; LCA inventory
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
units: t CO₂-eq/year; kg CO₂-eq/t; MWh/year; inventory flows
notes: The climate account applies the saved screening factor 0.20 kg CO₂e/kWh to modeled electricity. Heat and other inventory flows are shown separately and are not converted to CO₂e without factors. No offset or substitution credit is used.

description: Partial BioSTEAM financial accounts and constant-account NPV for baseline and selected non-PEF candidates
source_dataset: Baseline screening report; exact non-PEF Pareto reports
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Baseline uses benchmark product prices with zero optimization savings/subsidy. Candidate cases retain sampled savings and subsidy. CAPEX/OPEX are incomplete; NPV repeats nominal annual cash for 20 years at 8%.

description: Stage and unit energy hotspots with feed-normalized economic relation
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Only modeled utility demand is shown. No reagent series or empty reagent bars. Cash uses incomplete recorded OPEX/CAPEX and screening product prices.

description: Distribution of 1049 eligible saved non-PEF random design evaluations
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Monte Carlo here denotes the saved random design-space sampling. Route, throughput and economic assumptions vary independently. Frequencies are not calibrated probabilities or confidence intervals. Climate is electricity-only attributional burden.

description: Observed screening profit intensity against sampled candidate economic parameters
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Each dot is an actual saved BioSTEAM evaluation; other route and economic inputs vary simultaneously. Scatter is descriptive association, not one-factor causal sensitivity or a probability model.

description: Deterministic one-factor NPV sensitivity and two-factor price/OPEX surface for full-front rank 0
source_dataset: Full-front rank 0 recorded revenue, OPEX and partial capital
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Arithmetic postprocessing of one saved run. Price, OPEX and CAPEX tornado ranges are ±10%; discount is 6–10%. Tax is applied to positive operating surplus. These are explicit hypothetical bounds, not stochastic uncertainty intervals.

description: Paired protein-bypass economic and climate changes at fixed feed and economic assumptions
source_dataset: Full-front and matched protein-bypass exact BioSTEAM reruns
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Each pair changes only protein recovery to PR0. Negative climate change means lower electricity-only attributional burden. This is a deterministic intervention comparison, not statistical significance.

description: Feed-normalized solids, distinct raw/upgraded gas volumes, utility demand and annual feed for selected F1 routes
source_dataset: Exact F1 BioSTEAM reports and saved gas stream components
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Solid yields are reported stream mass, not pure nutrient mass. Export gas is raw for BG0 and upgraded for other BG routes. Gas volumes use dry ideal gas at 273.15 K and 101325 Pa. All routes use F1 without PEF.

description: Product-stream and utility intensities across two independently selected F1 fronts
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Independent ranks need not share feed or technology; intensities divide saved annual quantities by each run’s wet feed. Missing products appear as zero trajectories only where a bypass is meaningful.

description: Stage attributional electricity burden and separately inventoried heat across 22 selected F1 routes
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: F denotes full-front rank and B protein-bypass rank. Electricity is characterized at 0.20 kg CO₂e/kWh; heat has no validated factor and is not added to burden.

description: Deterministic attributional electricity factor scenarios on actual F1 utility inventories
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
units: kg CO₂-eq/kWh; t CO₂-eq/year; kg CO₂-eq/t; MWh/year; kWh/t
notes: Factor range 0.05–0.40 kg CO₂e/kWh is an explicit sensitivity sweep, not an empirical uncertainty distribution. Dashed line marks the saved screening factor 0.20. Heat and other missing LCA factors remain uncharacterized.

description: Deterministic electricity-factor, demand and operating-hours sensitivity of partial attributional burden
source_dataset: Exact F1 electricity and heat inventories
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Rank-0 tornado uses 0.15–0.25 kg CO₂e/kWh, ±10% electricity and ±5% operating hours as explicit hypothetical ranges. Hours affect annual burden but not per-tonne intensity at constant process rates. No full LCA or probabilistic interval is implied.

description: Distribution of actual sampled F1 design outcomes by protein technology route
scenario: F1 non-PEF saved BioSTEAM batch and selected exact reruns
notes: Violin widths describe the saved random design sweep, not empirical probabilities. Other technology, throughput and economic settings vary within each protein-route group. Electricity intensity is inferred from the saved 0.20 kg CO₂e/kWh electricity-only climate objective.
